correctness.rationale: The local reduction is exact: every peripheral open neighborhood contains the central and paired vertex with distinct colors; only the central parity condition remains. Orthogonality of finite sign characters counts assignments with every active color having odd occurrence count, and the pair sum equals (sum of signs)^2-k. The k=2 and k=4 evaluations and exclusion of smaller palettes prove the chromatic and optimal formulas for every m>=1. Direct graph enumeration in 18 (m,q) pairs, and an independently implemented parity-state dynamic program on 56 pairs, agree with the character formula.

Residual risk of broader parity-sequence enumeration or unlocated specialized literature remains.

value.rationale: A complete all-palette polynomial on the natural infinite planar friendship family determines solution-space sizes far beyond the minimum-color threshold. The sharp 3/5 parity split and exact exponentially growing optimal multiplicities arise from a nontrivial neighborhood-parity incidence condition and can guide exact enumerations on one-point-union and block-graph families. It is a motivated natural complete invariant, not a finite arbitrary slice.
